services.title: Business process optimization
services.short: Increase efficiency and cut costs with Kaizen, Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma and the Theory of Constraints.
services.body: We study your processes on site, map the value stream and identify waste. Then, together with your team, we implement an improvement plan and measure the result through KPIs.
services.problem: Do you know where time and money leak from your processes?

services.title: Energy audit and energy efficiency
services.short: Analyze energy consumption and identify losses: systems audit, process optimization and lower energy costs.
services.body: We measure and analyze the energy flows at your facility, pinpoint where losses occur, and provide an economic justification for savings measures.
deliverables: Savings measures and their payback period
services.problem: Paying more for energy than you should?

services.title: Strategy development
services.short: Strategy, business planning and product development management to achieve business goals, competitiveness and sustainable growth.
services.body: We analyze the market and competitors, identify the company's strengths, and build a development strategy and business plan with measurable goals.
services.problem: Do you know exactly where the company will be in 3 years?

services.title: Green finance
services.short: Developing and implementing green financial products and green lending programs for financial institutions.
services.body: We help banks and financial institutions create green lending programs, project assessment criteria and a climate risk management system.
services.problem: Is your bank ready for green lending?

services.title: Certification readiness
services.short: Implementing management systems and supporting the certification process for ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 50001.
services.body: We build a management system from scratch or align your existing one with the standard's requirements: documentation, processes, internal audit and preparation for the certification audit.
services.problem: Are international clients asking for ISO certification?

services.title: Project baseline
services.short: Setting the baseline for green projects: data collection, benchmarking and defining control points for measuring impact.
services.body: We record the pre-project situation in precise figures, so that later results and impact can be measured reliably.
services.problem: How will you prove the impact of your green project?

services.title: Data management
services.short: Implementing systems for collecting, storing, analyzing and managing data to support decision-making and operational efficiency.
services.body: We put in order where data comes from, how it is stored and who uses it and how, and we build reports and dashboards for management.
services.problem: Are your decisions driven by data?

services.title: Greenhouse gas accounting
services.short: Data collection, calculation of greenhouse gas (CO₂) emissions and reporting based on international standards.
services.body: We calculate a company's or project's CO₂ emissions using international methodologies and propose measures to reduce them.
services.problem: Do you know how much CO₂ your plant emits?

process.title: Diagnostics
process.text: Gemba: we observe processes on site, collect data and set the baseline.

process.title: Analysis
process.text: We identify waste, losses and bottlenecks using Lean, Six Sigma and the Theory of Constraints.

process.title: Solution
process.text: We build a clear action plan with a strategy, a roadmap and measurable KPIs.

process.title: Implementation
process.text: We implement changes together with your team, train staff and, where needed, digitalize.

process.title: Kaizen
process.text: We measure the result and move into a cycle of continuous improvement: the process never stops.

Our competitive strengths let us adapt quickly to changing market conditions and master new areas of consulting.
